_comment: Wand calibration of cam1 and cam2 through the water-filled acrylic tube, run 20261006/T2 (recorded about an hour after T0, same cameras and wand). Lengths in mm, image coordinates in px (u = column, v = row, pixel centres at integers). See 2026-10-06-plan.md.

image.camera: Phantom VEO 710L (from the .chd header; serials 29199 = cam1, 23752 = cam2, as in T0)

wand._comment: The wand of T0 (the user, 6 Oct): 10 mm long (centre to centre), balls 3 mm and 4 mm, rod about 2 mm. End A is the small ball.

detect._comment: T0's settings, unchanged: the same wand at the same magnification (P0: ball sizes within 1 % of T0's), and the opening scan still separates the balls at 91-101 px.
detect._workers: 16 processes: the file server (about 22 MB/s) limits the speed; T0 ran as fast with 16 as with 48.

accept._comment: T0's rules: a camera-frame is kept with two balls apart (the guard), both fits with an edge RMS at most edge_rms_max_px and an aspect ratio in aspect_range, and both sizes (sqrt(a b)) within size_tol of the camera's median for that ball. A frame is kept when every camera keeps it.

reference_T0._comment: Run T0 of the same day, for the cross-run tests.

reference_20260930._comment: cam1 in the dot-board case cyl_20260930_T0_cam1 (through the tube) and its focal check in air (5 Oct).
